headline: U.S. Strikes Iran Air Defense as Russia Barrages Ukraine for 23 Hours
subheadline: Russian launches from Kursk continued beyond 28 hours as Geran-5 strikes hit Rivne, Kyiv/Boryspil, and Kamianets-Podilskyi amid Iranian Qeshm Island explosions.
lede: A reported U.S. strike on an air defense system on Iran's Qeshm Island triggered explosions heard in Bandar Abbas, while Iranian MP Manouchehr Mottaki threatened to expand the conflict to Europe. Russia launched a massive, multi-axis Shahed and Geran-5 barrage lasting over 23 hours, with launches from Kursk continuing beyond 28 hours and strikes hitting at least 10 Ukrainian oblasts including Kyiv, Rivne, Vinnytsia, and Kharkiv. Israeli forces concluded an 11-day operation in Hebron and killed four Hamas operatives in northern Gaza, while Lebanon recorded 164 alerts and 88 drone sightings on November 2. Ukraine responded by striking three Russian refineries accounting for approximately 10 percent of refining capacity, including the Lukoil refinery in Kstovo, as Zelensky proposed a three-way summit with Putin and Trump in Istanbul.

sections.title: Russia Launches 23-Hour Multi-Axis Drone Barrage
sections.body: Russia launched a massive, multi-axis Shahed and Geran-5 barrage lasting over 23 hours, with launches from Kursk continuing beyond 28 hours. Confirmed Geran-5 strikes hit Rivne city, targeted the Kyiv/Boryspil area, and struck Kamianets-Podilskyi, while reactive UAVs from the Black Sea targeted Odesa, Mykolaiv, and Tatarbunary. Russian drone attacks killed two civilians and injured three children in Koziatyn, Vinnytsia region, and injured a 67-year-old man in Chernivtsi. Ukraine struck three Russian refineries accounting for approximately 10 percent of refining capacity, including the Lukoil-Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez facility in Kstovo, after the energy truce ended.

sections.title: U.S. Strikes Iran Air Defense on Qeshm
sections.body: Iranian reports said a U.S. strike hit an air defense system on Qeshm Island, triggering explosions heard in Bandar Abbas. Iranian MP Manouchehr Mottaki threatened to expand the conflict to Europe, claiming Iranian missiles can reach the continent. Israeli forces withdrew from several Hebron neighborhoods after an 11-day operation and killed four Hamas operatives in northern Gaza, including Nukhba Force member Wael Naif Fahmi Muslim and recruitment chief Nabil Hamad. Lebanon recorded 164 alerts and 88 drone sightings on November 2, including one drone strike in Kfar Tibnit, five airstrikes, and 27 artillery shelling incidents across southern districts.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Concurrent U.S. strikes on Iranian air defenses and Russia's 23-hour-plus drone barrage demonstrate sustained kinetic pressure across both theaters while Iran-U.S. talks continue through Qatar. Iranian threats to expand to Europe and Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries accounting for roughly 10 percent of capacity signal both sides are extending operational reach beyond immediate frontlines.
